Name is a bit misleading, this is a Line Friends store. They have a great selection of BT21 merchandise and much smaller selections of other idol group Line Friends merch, but no other kpop items and not every group with Line Friends characters is represented. The first floor was occupied by a pop-up when I visited, but I was able to visit the permanent second floor shop without needing to queue for the pop-up. Helpful staff, disappointing store.

All Google Maps reviews [...] Slide 1 of 3

Line Friends Hongdae is such a fun stop. The shop is lively, well laid out, and packed with cute character merch. The giant displays make it perfect for photos, and the staff are welcoming without being pushy. They also have good deals on certain items, which makes shopping even better. The quality is solid, and the range is wide enough to keep you browsing for a while. If you’re into BT21 or quirky collectibles, this spot is a must-visit.

results.title: What It Was Like Shopping at Korea's Beauty Central, Olive Young - Business Insider
results.content:
Every Olive Young outlet I went to had digital displays featuring K-pop boyband members, like Felix Lee of Stray Kids, an LVMH muse, and Seventeen member Jeonghan, the face of makeup brand Banila.

It made Sephora's posters of Western celebrities look low-key and understated. As an avid appreciator of K-pop men, I was not complaining. The displays enticed me to pick up a cream blush from Banila, which I did not need.

There's a reason displays at Olive Young are so K-pop-centric. [...] Over five days in South Korea, I visited eight Olive Young outlets across the Hongdae, Myeongdong, and Seongsu districts. I spent most of my time — but not all of my money — at the megastore in the Brooklyn-esque Seongsu, which houses a multi-floor K-beauty playground.

Before my Seoul sojourn, I asked Yang Hu, an analyst at the data analytics company Euromonitor International, about Olive Young's rise. [...] When I landed in South Korea in September, I told myself I would abide by one rule: Don't spend all your money at Olive Young.

Akin to Sephora and Ulta, Olive Young is a hub for Korean skincare and beauty brands. Beauty enthusiasts in the US who want to shop at Olive Young will get to do so stateside very soon: The company is planning to open its first store in the US in Los Angeles in the first half of 2026.
